Real audit: NOCK editor real/fast/browser but admin-only today; SHANKPIT already has a real (but dark-in-prod, unconfigured) Google OAuth flow -- more complete identity than DEADWEIGHT's guest-first model; SHANKPIT's own auth/queue/ticket handlers predate and sit outside IDUNA's newer generic games.Registry tenant system (real architectural seam named); BRAWLPIT has zero player IDUNA identity today. Named without guessing the single biggest open question -- what the shell technically is (browser vs SHANKPIT's native SDL2 client vs identity-only unification) -- 3 real options laid out, none picked. 4 priority-ordered open questions for the founder. SHANKPIT ad8ab52. Golden doc registered (SHANKPIT-OS-NORTH).

title: NORTHSTAR scoping pass: SHANKPIT OS platform pivot
